question_text: Ideal temperature to store insulin is :
explanation: Unopened insulin supplies must be refrigerated at $2^\circ\text{C}$ to $8^\circ\text{C}$ to maintain stability.

question_text: The type of glass possessing low coefficient of thermal expansion is:
explanation: Pyrex glass (borosilicate glass) contains boron oxide and has a very low coefficient of thermal expansion.

question_text: Following statement is more accurate with respect to limitations of Arrhenius relationship for stability prediction :

options.A: Less relative humidity and oxygen solubility at higher temperature
options.B: Same degradation mechanisms may predominate at different temperatures
options.C: Equal moisture concentrations will be mentioned at different temperatures
options.D: Order of degradation will alter at higher temperature

explanation: A primary limitation of the Arrhenius relationship in stability testing is that the degradation pathway or mechanism may change at elevated temperatures, leading to different degradation orders.

question_text: Type II glass containers are :

options.A: Most inert glasses and shows high hydrolytic resistance
options.B: Suitable for most acidic and neutral aqueous preparations

explanation: Type II glass consists of treated soda-lime-silica glass and is suitable for acidic and neutral aqueous preparations.

question_text: Lakes of Dyes available commercially contain maximum upto ______ of pure dye.
explanation: Commercial dye lakes typically contain between 10% to 50% pure dye depending on the specific aluminum or calcium substrate used.

question_text: An excipient Ludipress used for liquid Dosage form is a coprocessed excipient of :
explanation: Ludipress is a directly compressible excipient composed of lactose monohydrate, povidone (Kollidon 30), and crospovidone (Kollidon CL).

question_text: As per European Pharmacopoeia technical guide, substance stored at $25^\circ\text{C}$ for 24 hours at 80% RH, called very hygroscopic when increase in weight is :
explanation: According to the European Pharmacopoeia, very hygroscopic substances exhibit an increase in mass of 15% or more when subjected to specified humidity conditions.

question_text: In capsule making the Bloom strength of gelatin is proportional to molecular weight of the gelatin and is a measure of the;

options.A: Adhesive strength of gelatin with other polymer
options.B: Adhesive strength of gelatin with dipping pins
options.C: Cohesive strength of the crosslinking that occurs between gelatin molecules
options.D: Cohesive strength of the solvent molecules

explanation: Bloom strength measures the gel rigidity, which directly correlates to the cohesive strength of the crosslinked gelatin network.

question_text: Relative sweetness of sucrose, to saccharin :
explanation: Saccharin is generally considered to be approximately 200 to 700 times sweeter than sucrose, with 200 being the standard classical comparative ratio.

question_text: Pyrogens present in containers can be destroyed by heating the containers at :
explanation: Depyrogenation of glassware typically requires dry heat sterilization at temperatures of $250^\circ\text{C}$ for 30 minutes or $210^\circ\text{C}$ to $220^\circ\text{C}$ for at least 1 hour.

question_text: Dimethyl sulfoxide acts as penetration enhancer for topical formulations by :
explanation: DMSO acts primarily by altering the solvent properties of the stratum corneum lipid barrier, thereby enhancing drug permeation.

question_text: Which of the following is not a fundamental (primary) factor considered for selection of a location for the construction of pharmaceutical or chemical plant ?
explanation: While foundation soil stability is important in civil engineering, the primary macroeconomic factors for plant location are raw materials, market access, and labor supply.

question_text: While studying solid state physicochemical properties, the packing property of drug include :
explanation: Refractive index and density are related to molecular packing and spatial arrangement in the solid state.

question_text: The complexation of Quinine with hexyl salicylate is an example of absorption by :
explanation: Complexation that neutralizes charge or increases lipophilicity often promotes absorption via ion-pair formation.

question_text: Fraction of administered dose (which may be in form of an ester of salt) of active drug is termed as :
explanation: The salt factor ($S$) represents the fraction of the administered dose of a drug salt or ester that is active drug moiety.

question_text: The unequal attractive forces acting on the molecules at the surface of liquid gas interface when compared with molecular forces in the bulk of the liquid is due to :

options.C: Abscence of adhesive force of attraction
options.D: Abscence of cohesive force of attraction

explanation: Surface tension arises because molecules at the surface experience fewer adhesive forces with the gas phase compared to cohesive forces with neighboring liquid molecules.

question_text: The temperature dependence and the theory of viscosity is expressed by the following :
explanation: The temperature dependence of liquid viscosity is frequently modeled using an Arrhenius-type exponential relationship.

question_text: When a solid forms a gel more readily when gently shaken or otherwise sheared than when allowed to form the gel while the material is kept at rest, the phenomenon is known as :
explanation: Rheopexy is the property of certain non-Newtonian fluids to set up into a gel more quickly when subjected to gentle stirring or agitation.

question_text: When the concentration of an aqueous sodium chloride solution has the same colligative properties as the solution in question, the value so obtained is known as :
explanation: The isotonicity value refers to the concentration of sodium chloride that exhibits the same osmotic pressure or colligative properties as a given solution.

question_text: The polymorphs exhibit the following different properties Except :
explanation: Polymorphs have different physical properties (such as melting points, solubilities, and X-ray diffraction patterns), but they share the same chemical structure.

question_text: Centistoke is the CGS unit for the following property :
explanation: Centistoke (cSt) is the CGS unit for kinematic viscosity, while centipoise is used for dynamic viscosity.

question_text: Which of the following powder shows the greatest degree of dustibility ?
explanation: Lycopodium powder is well known for its uniform spore size and light nature, giving it an exceptionally high degree of dustibility.

question_text: The 'Crenulation' effect on the cell wall is caused by $______$ solutions and this effect is $______$
explanation: Crenulation occurs when cells are placed in hypertonic solutions due to water loss, and the process is typically reversible via plasmolysis/de-crenulation.

question_text: When six suppositories containing 20 percent of morphine hydrochloride in Theobroma oil are to be prepared, which of the following statement is correct ? (Given : Displacement value of morphine hydrochloride is 1.5; weight of each suppository is 1g)

options.A: The displacement value of morphine hydrochloride is to be considered
options.B: The displacement value of morphine hydrochloride is to be ignored
options.C: The displacement value of Theobroma oil is to be considered
options.D: The displacement values of both morphine hydrochloride and Theobroma oil are to be considered

explanation: When active ingredients have a density significantly different from the base (displacement value != 1), their displacement value must be considered to calculate the exact amount of base needed.

question_text: Increasing the proportion of the disperse phase of an emulsion by more than $60\%$ may lead to :
explanation: Exceeding the internal phase volume beyond 60-74% often results in phase inversion, where the internal and external phases swap.

question_text: Burow's solution is :
explanation: Burow's solution is an aqueous solution of aluminum acetate, commonly used as an astringent topical medication.

explanation: When the solute dimerizes in solvent B, its effective monomer concentration is proportional to the square root of its total concentration in solvent B ($C_B$).

question_text: Choose the wrong statement from the following with regard to Amorphous solids :

options.A: They tend to flow when subjected to sufficient pressure
options.B: They do not have definite melting point
options.D: They lack a well-defined ordered internal crystal lattice

explanation: Amorphous solids are typically isotropic (exhibiting similar properties in all directions), not anisotropic like most crystals.

question_text: The second law of thermodynamics states that 'whenever a spontaneous process takes place, it is accompanied by an increase in the total energy of the universe.' The equation that satisfies the above law is :
explanation: The total entropy change of the universe for any spontaneous process is the sum of the entropy change of the system and the surroundings, and it must be greater than zero.

question_text: When adhesive attractions between molecules of different species exceeds cohesive attraction between like molecules, the deviation according to Raoult's law is said to be :
explanation: Stronger adhesive forces than cohesive forces hold molecules together more tightly, resulting in a negative deviation from Raoult's law with decreased vapor pressure.

question_text: Molar heat capacity of a system is defined as :

options.A: The amount of heat required to raise temperature of one mole of the system by one Kelvin
options.B: The amount of heat required to decrease temperature of one mole of the system by one Kelvin
options.C: The amount of heat required to raise temperature of one mole of the system by one Fahrenheit
options.D: The amount of heat required to decrease temperature of one mole of the system by one Fahrenheit

explanation: Molar heat capacity is the quantity of heat needed to raise the temperature of one mole of a substance by one Kelvin.

question_text: The principle of liquid-liquid extraction is ____________.
explanation: Liquid-liquid extraction works on the principle of differential partition of a solute between two immiscible liquid phases.

question_text: The Crystal form of Sulphacetamide is :
explanation: Sulphacetamide typically crystallizes in the orthorhombic crystal system.

question_text: The general purpose sodalime glass is not a suitable material for fabricating the container for :
explanation: Sodalime glass leaches alkali into contents, making it unsuitable for parenteral preparations which require neutral or highly resistant glass.

question_text: In solid-solid mixing, large scale continuous type of mixer is:
explanation: The zigzag blender is typically utilized for continuous solid-solid blending on a large scale.

options.A: Most inert glasses and shows high hydrolytic resistance
options.B: Suitable for most acidic and neutral aqueous preparations

explanation: Type II glass is treated soda-lime glass, which has high hydrolytic resistance and is suitable for most acidic and neutral aqueous preparations.

question_text: In capsule making the Bloom strength of gelatin is proportional to molecular weight of the gelatin and is a measure of the;

options.A: Adhesive strength of gelatin with other polymer

question_text: Relative sweetness of sucrose, to saccharin :

explanation: Depyrogenation of glassware and containers typically requires dry heat sterilization at temperatures such as $250^\circ\text{C}$ for 30 min or $210^\circ\text{C}$ to $220^\circ\text{C}$ for 1 hour.

explanation: While foundation and soil properties matter during civil engineering design, primary plant location factors typically revolve around economics, raw materials, markets, and labor supply.

question_text: The version of GMP in India that describe requirement of factory premises for manufacture of cosmetics :
